exposure: indications for caesarean section (e.g., Previous LSCS)
type of caesarean section (emergency vs. elective)
cohort: Singleton pregnant women who delivered in a rural hospital in India between July and September 2023.
finding: The incidence of caesarean section in the rural setup was 42.16%, with 67.02% being emergency LSCS and previous LSCS (41.04%) being the most common indication.
mod_finding: The study found a caesarean section incidence of 42.16%, predominantly emergency LSCS (67.02%), with previous LSCS as the leading indication (41.04%).
